Hisham Abdo Kahin is Director of Operations Efficiency and Effectiveness in the World Bank's Operations Policy and Country Services Vice Presidency. He has held several managerial and leadership roles, both at the World Bank and outside it. At the Bank, he was Manager of the Investment and Program Lending Unit in Operations Policy and Country Services, Operations Manager for the India Country Management Unit, and Lead Counsel in the Legal Vice Presidency. Outside the Bank, he was Senior Adviser to the Government of Sudan.
